description: Local readings and the explicit query keep literal tags through recognition.
grammar:
%rule text [$x:"a"] m :: ∅
%rule r A :: T
%rule m M
%check same #·m
%conditions $.preceding-element.local-readings, $.preceding-element.onward.parse(["a"] …),
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = $.preceding-element.onward.parse(["a"] …).tags,
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = A
%warning "same"
